page_title: GET 0-1 SEV | Getafe v Sevilla 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+10' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
90+9' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90+7' Carles Alena (Getafe) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+6' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Getafe.
90+4' Jaime Mata (Getafe) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
90+4' The linesman signals that Jaime Mata (Getafe) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

90+3' Luis Milla (Getafe) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Orjan Nyland!
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jaime Mata (Getafe) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
88' Here is a change. Marcos Acuna is going off and Quique Sanchez Flores gives the last tactical orders to Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla).
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) replaces Isaac Romero.
88' Diego Rico (Getafe) is booked by the referee.
88' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) gets a yellow card.
88' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
87' Carles Alena (Getafe) plays a lovely through ball to Jaime Mata, but he can't beat Orjan Nyland and loses the ball.
87' Diego Rico (Getafe) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
86' Javier Iglesias Villanueva has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marcos Acuna (Sevilla).
82' Javier Iglesias Villanueva shows a yellow card to Jose Bordalas Jimenez (Getafe) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
81' Substitution. Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) on for Lucas Ocampos.
81' Quique Sanchez Flores prepares a substitution. Oliver Torres is replaced by Djibril Sow (Sevilla).
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Yellu Santiago will be replaced by Juanmi Latasa (Getafe).
79' The referee blows his whistle, Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
79' The linesman points to the corner flag, Getafe are going to take it.
75' The ball is out of play. Getafe will have a chance to score from a corner.
74' Yellow card. Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
71' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) replaces Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez.
71' Substitution. Oscar Rodriguez will be replaced by Carles Alena (Getafe).
66' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Loic Bade trots off the pitch and is replaced by Lucien Agoume (Sevilla).
62' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jaime Mata (Getafe) replacing Gaston Alvarez.
62' Substitution. Ilaix Moriba makes his way off the pitch and Diego Rico (Getafe) comes on as his replacement.
61' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
60' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
57' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) is caught offside!
51' Getafe get a corner.
48' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
48' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
47' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Javier Iglesias Villanueva has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Sevilla due to an offside in the build-up play.
45' The Sevilla players joy may have been justified, because referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
44' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
43' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
39' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) squandered a big chance! He got to the rebound inside the penalty box but only placed the ball against the left post!
39' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) rises above the defence and powers a header at the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with a superb save.
39' Sevilla have a corner.

39' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Sevilla force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
38' Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Orjan Nyland intercepts the ball.
37' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
36' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

32' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Orjan Nyland shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
31' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
30' The free kick is delivered by Mason Greenwood (Getafe) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
30' Loic Bade (Sevilla) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle for a foul. Getafe are awarded the free kick.
29' The Getafe players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
27' Djene (Getafe) jumps into a tackle and Javier Iglesias Villanueva signals a foul.
21' Kike Salas (Sevilla) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
19' The ball goes out for a corner. Sevilla can continue in their attacking effort.
18' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Orjan Nyland.
14' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
5' 0 - 1 Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) meets a cross from a well-taken corner kick and fires home. His effort goes into the bottom left corner and hits the net.
3' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
3' The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Getafe will take the kick-off.
